If this were to be implemented in the core, I am skeptical because it cannot be applied to individual points. In other words, it would completely overwrite the existing path. With such an implementation, this would match the rejection case for the proposal, where "it would be sufficient as an add-on".

So probably, in addition to the current implementation, which applies to all paths, implementing a toggle option that applies this only to the clicked point as similar to deletion mode would provide the justification for implementing this in the core.
Except the errors, looks fine now.
It seems my previously mentioned concerns have been resolved. Please revise the comment format and squash the changes into single commit.
Code looks good, haven't tested functionality

Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

**Testing project:** [test_pr_116392.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32019349/test_pr_116392.zip)

I think it's in a much better state now, especially since you can apply automatic smoothing to certain points only or choose a different smoothing factor. Creating smooth paths for camera rails is much quicker with this, especially in 3D.

cc @passivestar in case you want to take a look in terms of UX.
Looks good on my end, but I'd like to get an UX review from @godotengine/usability before merging this.
